note: ADR-0500 withdrew URL-in-`--database`, so a URL there must be a usage error (exit 2) naming `--load <url>`; remote bundle support belongs on `--load`, reusing ADR-0496's GitHub rewrite, https/loopback policy, `.cl`-only check and capped streaming staged fetch, with ephemeral open on `:memory:` and clone into a durable target.

Query already exists as a first-positional statement-session verb in ADR-0200 (grammar, `--database`, help), so extend that and keep the did-you-mean usage-error behavior of ADR-0518 intact rather than adding a new command.

Add the procedure with CIP-287-style no-database-argument signature, put it behind the CYPHERLITE_PREVIEW `ontology` gate and the PreviewFeature registry, honor the implicit/explicit transaction rules, keep it in the always-built ontology crate and list it in SHOW PROCEDURES.

Extend the re-arrival trail-existence rule in the frontier kernel (accept-on-arrival before dedup, structural and answer-shape gates, work budget fall-through), and verify under the diagnostic RELATE_PATTERN_ENGINE switch.

ADR-0306 already specifies read-only/follow for `serve` and the MCP binary, with the Docker entrypoint passing the valueless flags through; but ADR-0368 retired the standalone mcp bin, so the MCP part now goes through `serve --mcp` and the entrypoint supervising `cypherlite serve`.

The `snapshot` verb is already decided in ADR-0159 (read-only source, destination must not exist, codec preserved, Database snapshot/restore methods, always compiled), so implement it per that on top of the `.cl` bundle and read-only open rules.
